mainEntity.name: How does AEO help a pool contractor get more local clients?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO is crucial for local pool contractors because many search queries for local services are question-based (e.g., 'who builds pools near me?' or 'best pool maintenance in Los Angeles?'). By optimizing for these questions, your business can be presented as the direct answer, often with your location and contact details. This prominence helps capture customers actively searching for local pool services, driving more targeted leads and foot traffic to your business or website.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO helps local pool contractors by optimizing for question-based local searches, positioning the business as the direct answer with contact details, and driving targeted leads.
